reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "scheduling flake due to nodepool readiness (#6491) #6491 (Jason Deal)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: After upgrading to v1.0.0, Karpenter scheduling no longer intermittently flakes due to nodepool readiness; environments that experienced the flake see it resolved.
consequence.remediation: None required; the fix ships with the upgrade.

proposed.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 fixes an intermittent scheduling flake caused by nodepool readiness handling (PR #6491), changing scheduling behavior with no configuration change on the operator side.
